Title: Azure Blockchain Service is now available in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Blockchain Service is a fully managed blockchain service in Azure. Use it to grow and operate blockchain networks at scale with simplified network formation, management, and governance. By eliminating the burden of building, managing, and growing the underlying network, and by automating governance tasks such as adding new members, setting permissions, and monitoring node health, Azure Blockchain Service empowers users to focus on what matters to them—business logic and app development. Learn more at our Azure blog or get started and create a blockchain network in the Azure portal today.

Create a blockchain network in the Azure portal
